title: game/data/regions.json: what a run's region is made from (roguelite track RL-R1, logic/run-region.js)

zones.description: the zones a region has at each Expedition, I first (past the last, the last)

rows.description: a zone's rows on the run's map: fewest, most

dex.description: the regional dex's species (every stage and form counts): fewest, most

graph.description: the biome graph: each biome's likely next zones, by weight (biomes.json ids; only biomes with finished plants)

weight.description: how often it rolls (1 if missing)

start.description: the first zone's biome, by weight

biomes.description: its biomes, by weight (times the graph's)

types.description: the types it leans to (types.json ids): its dex's lines and its leaders

ends.description: its own name endings, joined on ("mere")

nouns.description: its own name nouns, after a space ("Shores")

parts.description: a name's first part ("Pending"); one of two words takes only a noun

joined.description: the odds a one-word part takes an ending (Pendingvale) rather than a noun (Beta Basin)
